name: det-simd-strictfp
title: Determinism S1 (B1, B2): force-scalar SIMD tier setting and a strict-FP compile profile (issue #157)
issue: Analysis: C:/Method Notes Obsidian/orchestrator/proposals/physx-limitations-and-determinism.md (read sections 3, 4.4 and 5 fully first: the blocker inventory B1-B10 with file/line evidence; the line numbers are from master 7222391, re-verify each against the code before editing; docs/prose must be verified against CODE). This is stage 'S1 (cheap)' of the determinism plan (issue #157): small, CI-verifiable changes that are useful even without netcode (reproducible replays and tests). HARD RULES: default behaviour of every existing project/scene/test must be UNCHANGED unless the new setting/option is switched on; no protocol change; no network presets yet (that is stage S2, not this item); no new third-party dependency. Nothing builds locally; the PR's CI (9 checks) is the test, so write tests that run on every leg and keep platform-specific expectations out of them. List unverified items honestly. No Co-Authored-By trailer and no 'Generated with Claude Code' footer. SCOPE: (B1) add a way to choose the math SIMD tier instead of always auto-detecting: a project/engine setting (follow how existing engine settings are read in Application.cpp near the Math::InitializeSIMD call; values Auto (default) / Scalar / the other tiers that exist) applied BEFORE any scene load, with a log line naming the tier in use; forcing a tier the CPU lacks must refuse or clamp with a warning (decide, document). Tests: with Scalar forced, a fixed set of Vector3/Quaternion/Matrix operations gives results equal to the scalar reference functions EXACTLY (ASSERT bit equality), and Auto still passes the existing tolerance tests. Document which ops differ bit-wise across tiers today (Quaternion dot ordering, Vector3 normalize reciprocal-multiply vs divide per B1) in docs: do NOT change the tier implementations in this item. (B2) add CMake option N2ENGINE_STRICT_FP (default OFF) that on GCC/Clang adds -ffp-contract=off to ALL engine targets (not only math/aarch64), on MSVC sets /fp:precise explicitly and never /fp:contract, forbids -march=native/-ffast-math, and defines N2_STRICT_FP; expose a runtime query (e.g. Math::IsStrictFp()) for the later startup check. Turn the option ON in ONE existing CI leg that is cheap (pick the linux x86_64 GCC 14 leg unless a better one exists; do not rename any job) so the flag is exercised. Docs: a short section in the relevant docs page (find the math/testing docs).
acceptance: Default build and all existing tests unchanged
Forcing Scalar gives bit-exact results vs the scalar reference in a test
N2ENGINE_STRICT_FP exists, is ON in one CI leg, defines N2_STRICT_FP, and is documented
Tier in use is logged at startup
notes: Reviewer: confirm defaults unchanged, the setting is applied before scene load, flags are applied to all targets only when the option is ON, MSVC and GCC/Clang branches both correct, the CI leg edit changes no job name.
